thread:
alex: Heads up — we're cutting rc-1.4.0 today. Need coordinated version stamps across api, runtime, console, and sdks. Please confirm PRs, changelog snippets, and any blocking migrations. No runtime dep bumps after 14:00 PT.

maria: Ack. I have API PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/489 — adds new /v1/generate param. Will append changelog entry under `Unreleased` and tag it `rc-1.4.0`. Planning to merge in ~20m if CI is green. :thumbsup:

jamal: Runtime PR needs manual perf sanity checks because of the new KV cache change — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1246. Can we gate merge on canary results? If canary passes, I'll cut the merge immediately.

sophie: Console has a small schema migration for the model card panel. I'll open the PR now and link it here. We need the API change from maria or console tests will fail.

alex: Thanks. Process checklist: 
- API: merge PR + changelog + semver tag (maria)
- Runtime: gated on canary (jamal)
- Console/SDKs: bump client deps after api tag (sophie + sdk owners)
- Release docs: add one-line summary for release notes (alex)

alex: Quick command for people doing local bumps (copy/paste):
```bash
# from repo root
./scripts/bump-version.sh --repo runtime --version 1.4.0-rc.0 --tag rc-1.4.0
git push origin HEAD && gh pr create --title "chore: version 1.4.0-rc.0" --body "bump"
```

maria: CI is green on API. Merging in 3.

ci-bot: [ci] api build passed — https://ci.redwood/1234 :white_check_mark:

maria: merged and tagged rc-1.4.0 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/commit/abcd1234

jamal: Starting runtime canary. I'll post results in ~10m.

dev-bot: runtime canary started on ci-canary-7 (20% traffic) — run id 8812.

jamal: Canary metrics look stable for 15m, p99 latency +2ms, error rate unchanged. Approving runtime PR for merge.

alex: Great. Jamal, please merge and push the semver tag. Sophie, once API tag is in place you can bump the sdk dependency and open PRs for console + node/pip SDKs.

sophie: Will do. Opening console PR now and will coordinate sdk owners (ryan for node, priya for python).

alex: If anyone needs to hold a repo for hotfixes, flag it here. Otherwise plan: all merges by 17:00 PT, smoke tests by 18:00 PT, RC announcement after that.

maria: No holds from API side.

jamal: Runtime merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/ef01bead

sophie: Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/202 — bumped api client to rc tag and added migration. Assigning @alex for quick review.

alex: Reviewing now. Also: small reminder to add one-sentence regression note in the changelog if you touched inference tuning knobs. Helps PMs triage.

sophie: Added changelog line under `Unreleased` + linked migration in PR.

dev-bot: smoke-test pipeline triggered by tag rc-1.4.0 — https://ci.redwood/smoke/77

ci-bot: smoke tests passed :tada: — publish window open.

alex: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll draft the release announcement and post in #announcements after we push the RC artifacts. :rocket:

maria: Nice job team.

jamal: thanks, everyone.

sophie: :party_popper:

dev-bot: Reminder scheduled: release checklist follow-up in 24h.
